scope: All-repeat descriptive analysis of the six-episode fresh development shard
readout_and_comparators: Frozen before fresh collection; no refitting from this shard
probability_controls: Global/task priors derived only from eligible original training episodes, seeds 2 through 7
brier: Mean binary squared probability error over each of the three repeats, then candidates within state, states within episode, and episodes
selection: Choose one fixed candidate using frozen scores before downstream outcomes; preserve first-index argmax ties
random_control: Exact expectation over all bank candidates including candidate zero
simulator_diagnostic: One fixed candidate maximizing empirical mean success over three repeats; unavailable deployment upper bound on this measured sample
populations: Report all collected decisions, plus the legacy subset where no candidate in the nested bank succeeded during its prefix. The eligibility mask is offline instrumentation and cannot be a controller input.
uncertainty: Paired descriptive bootstrap of complete source episodes only; six clusters are too few for strong claims
analysis_history: All-state sensitivity reporting and training-prior controls were added during collection after reach progress labels were visible. This is not a preregistered confirmatory analysis; collection, frozen models, candidate choices and original eligible-subset reporting were unchanged.
score_verification: Initial 1e-6 tolerance exposed maximum 1.3411e-6 cross-system float32 score differences; all nested-bank choices matched. Documented absolute tolerance 5e-6; immutable VM scores and frozen checkpoints unchanged.
